_about: Hand-curated like tariffs.json: sites the facility databases map without an operator, with the official page that names who runs them. An entry applies to an operator-less cluster whose centre is within radius_m of (lat, lon). The claim and quote are what the verifier checks against source_url; a stale entry shows up as contradicted or unverifiable, never as fact.

entries.name: Apple Maiden data center
entries.source_title: Apple Newsroom, August 2025: Apple increases U.S. commitment to $600 billion
entries.quote: Apple is expanding the capacity of its state-of-the-art data center in Maiden, North Carolina.
entries.claim: Apple operates a data center in Maiden, North Carolina, and is expanding its capacity.
